description: EXQ-TYPO10 edge empty-vs-nonempty: empty comparison (0 text rows, 4 default gutter chars) vs non-empty comparison (2 rows, line numbers, inline diff). Proves monospace consistency, vertical rhythm (15.6px mono fits in 18/24/28px row heights without clipping), and tree indent/alignment across both empty and non-empty models at 960x600 and 720px fallback.
